title: Foundations of Aqeedah — Planting Iman in the Young
description: A 12-lesson pathway that teaches the father/mother the foundations of the correct Islamic aqeedah so they can teach their children (ages 3-12). Built upon the Qur’an and Sunnah according to the understanding of the Salaf of the Ummah, far from disputes.

primary_reference.info: al-Aqidah al-Tahawiyyah; al-Qawa'id al-Arba' and Thalathat al-Usul by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab; Ibn Uthaymin's commentary; As'ilat al-Atfal al-Imaniyyah (al-Rukaf); al-Aqidah Awwalan (al-Juraysh)

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses plural 'دروس' after the number 12, which is grammatically incorrect in Modern Standard Arabic; it should be singular accusative.
The English drops the adjective «قصيرة» (short), so the lessons' brevity — a key practical point for parents — is lost.
